scope_support.feedback_quote: The coding agent examines demonstrations alongside its own rollout history, extracts strategies and the conditions under which they apply, and turns them into reusable harness components.
scope_support.object_quote: Harness evolution enables frozen language model agents to adapt to unfamiliar tasks by modifying the external programs that govern their behavior.
